say:1:1523208001:0.text: I never imagined that a casual conversation with my old friend could hold the key to ending this upheaval...

say:2:1523208002:1.text: Thank goodness I tucked the letter away deep in a drawer, and it didn't get completely soaked in the flood.
say:2:1523208002:1.source_cn: 还好，还好……我存在抽屉深处，没让它在那场洪灾里完全泡烂。

document:6:365:0.text:
Dear Bakis,
I am researching improved wild crops.

Progress is promising; I harvested the first batch of improved seeds, stored in <style="highlight">my small garden wooden box</style>.

Perhaps in time, we will have another edible crop besides wheat. It may not match wheat in taste, texture, or yield, but it can sustain life.

Call it my overthinking, old friend!

Yet if golden abundance ever leaves this land, these seeds could save lives, offering a glimmer of hope for you and me...
document:6:365:0.source_cn:
致老友比博：
我正在开展一项有关改良野生作物的研究。
研究进展还不错，我已经收获了第一批改良后的作物种子，它们都储存在<style="highlight">我家那片小种植园中的木箱中</style>。
或许再过一段时间，我们就能得到除小麦之外的另一种可食用作物了。当然，它的口感、味道、产量恐怕都不如小麦，但它能作为食物。
就当是我杞人忧天吧，老友！
但倘若真有一天，黄金的丰饶不再眷顾这片大地，这些种子或许能救人一命，能为你和我争取到一丝希望的可能……
（后续的字迹被水渍模糊，你已无法辨识出其中内容）
